annotations.title: Save a clip as a template

description:
Use this when the user wants a clip's look kept to use again: "save this style", "remember this edit",
        "make this my template", "clip my next streams like this". Saves the clip's whole edit (format and layout,
        captions, colour, effects, transitions, music, text and sounds) as one of the user's templates, also shown in
        RipClip under Templates; a clip of any length works. clip_id: from list_clips.
        name: what the user calls it (up to 60 characters). category: hype, story, montage, podcast or another group
        that edit_catalog(kind="templates") shows. description: an optional line about it.
        for_new_clips: true when the user wants future clips to get this look ("always", "from now on", "my next
        VODs"): it also becomes their default clipping preset (format, captions, headline look, logo, music), applied
        to every new clip find_clips and clip_range make. Ask if unclear.
        look_from (no clip_id needed): a TikTok or YouTube link to someone else's clip whose look the user wants ("make
        my clips look like this"): its captions and layout are read and saved as a clipping preset (Premium).
        Not for: putting a saved style on a clip (style_clip with template) or a single caption style (style_clip).
        Free: no Horizon Units. Next: style_clip(template=...) on other clips.
name: save_template
title: Save a clip as a template
